title: Zero Forcing in Generalized Petersen Graphs
headline: Completed alternative Lean formalisation and Palomar-verified implementation of $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every $n\ge 13$; no publication is planned after the prior-art audit found earlier public proofs/formalisations.
description: Completed formal-verification project for the theorem $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every $n\ge 13$. The project developed and audited an alternative proof architecture, completed a Lean 4 formalisation, and registered the verified snapshot with Palomar. A subsequent prior-art audit found an earlier public proof and an earlier independent Lean formalisation, so the project is retained as an alternative formalisation method and will not proceed to a research paper or arXiv submission.
verification: Mathematical proof audit passed; complete Lean formalisation passed its kernel and transitive-axiom audits; Palomar technical verification passed and the immutable snapshot is registered as PALOMAR-2026-09-27-000004 v1.
attribution: The corrected target appears as Conjecture 5 in Arnav Krishnan's July 2026 preprint A correction to the Zero Forcing Number of the Generalized Petersen Graphs P(n,3) (arXiv:2607.19412v1). The project's prior-art audit subsequently found an earlier public proof package and an earlier independent Lean formalisation. This repository therefore makes no priority or publication claim and is retained as an alternative formalisation and verification method.
